title: ScreenResponseV1
description: Top 20 of a five-minute screen snapshot. `rows` is always the top 20 of the requested region/sort; `total` is the full post-filter/post-dedupe universe, which may be larger than 20.

screen_id.description: Opaque snapshot id; the same value for every read inside the 300 s window.

source.description: `multi` is the verified consensus (P10 default); `tradingview` is the raw snapshot, either requested explicitly or served degraded when no verifier answered.

selection_source.description: Present on multi-source documents: the source the twenty candidates were selected from. Always TradingView.

degraded.description: Present on multi-source documents. True means verification failed and the raw snapshot is being served; never true with source=multi.

verification_error.description: Present on multi-source documents: why verification fell back to the snapshot. Null on a healthy consensus.

next_refresh_at.description: When the snapshot becomes refreshable; null only for an incomplete stored row.

stale.description: True when a refresh was blocked and the previous snapshot is being served honestly.

total.description: Full post-filter/post-dedupe universe size, not the page size.

returned.description: Rows in this response; always 20 unless the universe is smaller.

sourceSummary.description: How a consensus row was produced (P10). Present only when source=multi; an unverified snapshot row has no summary.

source_count.description: Sources that published at least one number for the row.

agreement.description: Share of change observations within the tolerance of the median change; null when no source published a change.

spread_pp.description: max−min change in percentage points; null with fewer than two change observations.

turnover_usd.description: Null for non-USD listings until an FX rate is applied; never invented.

source_summary.description: Present on a multi-source row (source=multi): the medians that built it and how much the sources agreed. Never per-source cells.
